title: Set up the shared foundation on a development machine
caption: docs/mvp/local-development.md §2. Every password here is a committed development value (development only).

steps.title: Install and copy the env file
steps.body: Node 24 (`.nvmrc`), pnpm, PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Mailpit. Then `pnpm install` and `cp .env.example .env.local`.

steps.title: Key files
steps.expect: `.local/keys/` (0700) with `master-v1.key`, `api-key-pepper`, `document-url.key`, `platform-jwt-ed25519.pem`, `ota-jwt-ed25519.pem` (each 0600) and `.local/storage/`. A second run prints `kept` for every file.

steps.title: Build the packages
steps.body: `pnpm build` (Turborepo builds packages before apps; `generate` runs first).

steps.title: Migrate
steps.body: `pnpm db:migrate` then (after a demo OTA exists) `pnpm db:migrate:tenants`.
steps.expect: One JSON line per applied file on the first run, nothing on the second. `platform.schema_migrations` lists 0001–0004 and `R__ota_read_access`.

steps.title: Reference data
steps.expect: One `reference.loaded` JSON line; a second run reports zeros everywhere.

steps.title: Stub and Mailpit
steps.expect: `amadeus-stub: listening on http://127.0.0.1:4900 (ready in … ms; …`; Mailpit UI reachable.
